note: Second calibration sample. Stage 1 applies inclusion 1, 4, 5 and exclusions 1-3, 6; scale (inclusion 2) and the adoption bar (inclusion 3) are deferred to Stage 2. Decisions bias toward inclusion; confidence reports certainty in the decision.

decisions.notes: Automatic short-answer grading; LLM application, no efficiency method.
Spoken NER data generation; no fine-tuning efficiency component.
Zero-shot decision tree induction; LLM application.
Matryoshka embedding training for IR. Targets representation efficiency, not LLM fine-tuning or adaptation cost; boundary call.
Oesophageal adenocarcinoma immunology; off-topic retrieval artefact.
5W1H extraction via prompting; explicitly fine-tuning-free application.

'6 LLM Fine-Tuning: Instruction and PEFT' in 'Generative AI and LLMs', record type Books. On-topic but appears to be a textbook chapter rather than primary research. Excluded under exclusion 6 with low confidence; flag if book chapters are to count as archival.
Moxin-LLM open-source 7B release covering pretraining through GRPO. Model release, not an efficiency method; engages exclusion 1 in part.
GPS trajectory re-identification; off-topic.
Causal interpretation of GPT attention; interpretability.

Instruction fine-tuning of 7-8B LLMs for financial classification. Domain application; efficiency framing is model-size choice rather than a fine-tuning efficiency method. Advanced under bias-to-inclusion for Stage 2 to resolve.
Compares QLoRA, RAFT and RLHF as fine-tuning methods; QLoRA comparison is squarely block B1/B2.
ABSA evaluation that explicitly compares ICL against PEFT. Evaluation of PEFT is in scope, but the paper's subject is the task, not the method.
Evaluation of LLMs on mental health tasks; no efficiency component.
'A Comprehensive Evaluation of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning on Automated Program Repair'. No abstract, but the title states a PEFT evaluation unambiguously.
PEFT evaluation for code smell detection; explicit PEFT adaptation of LLMs.
Quantization strategies for LLMs including effects on instruction-tuned models. Risk of being inference-only PTQ (exclusion 2); the instruction-tuning angle keeps it in for Stage 2.
Explainable AI guide; XAI, not efficiency. Also book-form.
Survey of small language models covering compression and fine-tuning cost. Survey route of criterion 2 applies, but the SLM focus may fall outside the LLM boundary at Stage 2.
Zero-shot link prediction on knowledge graphs; LLM application.
FISTAPruner post-training pruning without retraining; compression for deployment rather than fine-tuning. Boundary against the quantization block.
FPGA CNN-transformer hybrid with Neural ODE; hardware design, not LLM adaptation.
Diagnostic captioning decoding mechanism; application.
Lock-free memory reclamation; systems work unrelated to LLMs.
Secure distributed LLM fine-tuning placing LoRA / P-tuning v2 structures in a TEE. Federated fine-tuning is in scope; the contribution is primarily a security architecture.
Federated PEFT of SAM for 3D segmentation. PEFT plus federated is in scope, but SAM is a vision model and may fail criterion 2.
CGC-LoRA multi-task fine-tuning framework for LLMs; core LoRA method work.
MediNotes clinical note generation using LLMs and RAG; application, no stated efficiency method.
Multilingual generative AI for SMEs with limited hardware. Resource framing is deployment context, not a fine-tuning efficiency contribution.
Hopfieldian interpretation of chain-of-thought; interpretability.
Knowledge plug-and-play dialogue test bed; application.
LLM-based ranking for counter-narrative evaluation; evaluation method.
Ontology concept placement; application.
Glucose-monitoring sensor foundation model; pretraining in a non-language domain.
Med-VTAB visual task adaptation benchmark using learnable layers and tokens, i.e. PEFT for ViTs. Vision domain-boundary case against the LLM scope.
TSMamba time-series model built on Mamba; non-transformer architecture.
Zero-shot weight transfer to cut pre-training cost; pre-training efficiency only.
Memory-guided transformer for time-series forecasting; 'memory' is architectural, not resource use.
Multi-LLM debiasing framework; fairness, not efficiency.
Hallucination detection method; application.
Non-uniform 2-bit quantization for LLMs, referencing use in both compression and fine-tuning. Likely inference-side (exclusion 2); the fine-tuning reference keeps it in for Stage 2.
Data-free knowledge distillation for non-IID federated learning; generic FL, no LLM.
'A Note on LoRA' extending the original LoRA paper with deployment-at-scale insights; core PEFT.
Vietnamese vision-language model; general-purpose model, no efficiency method.
Deep graph prompt tuning that cuts training storage. Prompt tuning is in the PEFT family, but graph transformers are outside the language-model boundary.
Verbalizer construction for prompt tuning. Prompt tuning is a PEFT family member, though the contribution is closer to prompt design than efficiency.
LLM-driven robot behaviours; application with explicitly zero tuning.
Parameter-efficient multi-step fine-tuning for Japanese dialect ASR. PEFT method, speech domain-boundary.
Parameter-efficient language extension for multilingual ASR. PEFT method, speech domain-boundary.
LLM time-series reasoning via visualization; benchmark.
Evaluation of AI-generated text detectors; no efficiency component.
Quantization plus a PEFT library to shrink Llama-2-7B, GPT-J and LLaMA; combines both core blocks.
RAG for competency question generation in ontology engineering; application.
Review of LLMs in radiology; domain review, not efficiency.
General LLM review covering architectures and applications. Broad surveys touch efficiency, but efficiency is not the subject.
Federated learning for IoT attack robustness; security, no LLM.
KV cache compression via L2 norm; inference-time memory only.
Structured output for information extraction; application.
Analysis of LoRA's low-rank matrices and their relation to pretrained weights; core PEFT theory.
Spark parameter tuning; unrelated to LLMs.
Accuracy comparison of first-generation transformers against open LLMs; no efficiency contribution.
'A Study of Optimizations for Fine-tuning Large Language Models' addressing fine-tuning memory and resource budget; directly in scope.
Text classification study built on quantization, prefix tuning, LoRA and prompting as customization techniques.
Hypernetwork plus LoRA for text-to-image diffusion. LoRA method work in a diffusion/vision setting; criterion 2 risk.
Multi-view clustering survey; unrelated.
Survey of LLMs in biomedicine; domain survey.
AI-driven mock interview system using RAG and QLoRA. Uses an efficiency method but the subject is the application.
Survey of event causality identification; task survey.
Survey of LLM hallucination; not efficiency.
Survey of low-bit LLMs covering basics, systems and algorithms; quantization survey in block B2.
Survey of backdoor attacks and defenses. Notes PEFT and outsourced training as context, but the subject is security.
'A Survey of Resource-efficient LLM and Multimodal Foundation Models' spanning training to deployment; squarely in scope.
Survey of figurative language generation; task survey.
Survey of efficient federated learning for foundation model training; federated fine-tuning block.
Survey of efficient inference for LLMs; inference-only by its own framing.
Survey of efficient vision transformers. Efficiency-focused but non-language; fails the LLM boundary in criterion 2.
Survey of in-context learning, a fine-tuning-free adaptation paradigm. In scope only if adaptation without training counts under criterion 1; flagged for that judgement.
Survey of KV cache management for LLM acceleration; inference-time.
Survey of LLMs for code generation; task survey.
Survey of LLMs for network and service management; domain survey.
Survey of point-of-interest recommendation; unrelated.
Survey of privacy in B5G/6G networks; unrelated.
Survey of securing image-centric edge intelligence; unrelated.
Survey of agent memory mechanisms; 'memory' is agent state, not resource consumption.
Hierarchically pruned attention for model serving; inference-time, explicitly training-free.
Dialogue state tracking evaluation with GPT-4; evaluation method.
Zero-shot dialogue understanding pipeline; application.
Review of model compression techniques. Compression overlaps block B2, but the scope is general ML rather than LLM fine-tuning.

'A comprehensive study on quantization techniques for large language models', 146 citations, no abstract available. Title cannot separate training-time from inference-only quantization, so confidence stays low.
Theory of robustness for Bregman divergence losses; unrelated.
Fine-tuning-enhanced RAG system built on LoRA and QLoRA; core methods.
Adapter-based transfer learning for HVAC fault detection. Adapters are in scope as a method, but the models are small and non-language.
Review of non-IID techniques in federated learning; generic FL without an LLM component.
Prompt templates for zero-shot audio classification; prompt design, not tuning.
Survey of LLM safety and trustworthiness; not efficiency.
'A survey on LoRA of large language models'; the core PEFT survey for block B1.
Survey of multilingual LLMs; corpora, alignment and bias.
Synthetic data for NLI domain generalization; data method.
Survey of AI robustness; unrelated.
AAT adapts audio transformers with adapters instead of full fine-tuning. PEFT method, audio domain-boundary.
ABQ-LLM arbitrary-bit quantized inference acceleration; inference-only by title and abstract.
Legal document summarization with T5 and QLoRA; application. Record type is a conference abstract, which may also engage exclusion 6.
Adaptive compression for on-device CNN training; convolutional networks only.
ACCEPT adaptive codebook for composite prompt tuning; explicit PEFT method.
ACCO overlaps communication with computation for sharded LLM training and optimizer state; training-time memory and communication, block B3.
Auto-constriction turning for multilingual MT. Prompt-tuning is used as machinery for a translation contribution.
Anomaly detection benchmark for LLMs; benchmark.
ADAPT robustifies prompt tuning for vision transformers and cites per-task storage of billion-parameter models. PEFT method, vision domain-boundary.
Ambiguity-aware emotion recognition with LLMs; application.
AFLoRA adaptively freezes low-rank adaptation paths; core PEFT method.
AFPQ asymmetric floating-point quantization to save memory and accelerate inference. Inference-side, but quantization of LLMs sits close to block B2.
Fine-tuned Llama3 for Palestinian legal understanding; domain application.
ALLoRA addresses LoRA's dropout, initialization and learning-rate flaws; core PEFT method.
ALPS one-shot pruning for LLMs without retraining; compression for deployment.
ALoRA allocates LoRA rank adaptively for downstream tasks; core PEFT method.
AM-SAM automated prompting and mask calibration for SAM; vision segmentation quality, not adaptation cost.
Malicious model detection in IoT federated learning; security, no LLM.
AMAGO-2 meta-reinforcement learning with transformers; multi-task RL, not adaptation efficiency.
APEER automatic prompt engineering for reranking; prompt engineering rather than parameter-efficient tuning.
APT-Pipe prompt-tuning tool for ChatGPT annotation. 'Prompt tuning' here means prompt design, not a PEFT method.
APT adaptive prefix-tuning for code intelligence; explicit PEFT method addressing full-parameter cost.
APT combines adaptive pruning and tuning of pretrained LMs for efficient training and inference; training-time efficiency is central.
Architectural planning for Minecraft agents; application sharing the APT acronym.
APTQ post-training mixed-precision quantization for edge deployment; inference-side quantization.
APrompt4EM augmented prompt tuning for entity matching. Prompt tuning of PLMs is in the PEFT family; the subject is the data-management task.
AQLoRA adaptive quantization-based efficient fine-tuning for LLMs. No abstract, but the title names quantized efficient fine-tuning directly.
ARB-LLM binarization for LLM compression and deployment; inference-side compression.
ARL2 aligns retrievers for black-box LLMs; retrieval method.
ASLoRA shares low-rank matrices across layers to cut tunable parameters further; core PEFT method.
ASR error correction with LLMs, explicitly without access to weights; application.
Domain-Prompts trains a small set of pluggable domain embeddings for ASR adaptation with low memory overhead. PEFT method, speech domain-boundary.
Chinese ASR error correction benchmark; benchmark.
ATFLRec uses LoRA on an instruction-tuned LLM for multimodal recommendation. LoRA is machinery for a recommender contribution.
AV-PEA parameter-efficient adapter for audio-visual learning, motivated by trainable-parameter and storage cost. PEFT method, multimodal domain-boundary.
AXOLOTL post-processing self-debiasing; fairness, not adaptation cost.
Compares DPO against SFT for long-context capability. Fine-tuning methods compared for capability, not for resource cost.
Abstractive summarization from audio transcription, explicitly motivated by LoRA and quantization to avoid large compute. Efficiency methods are applied rather than advanced.
Communication-efficient federated multi-task learning; efficiency is real but the setting is generic FL, not LLM adaptation.
Closed-form classifiers to accelerate heterogeneous federated learning; no LLM component.
4D parallelism with a memory consumption estimator for LLM training; training-time memory, block B3.
Hybrid GPU-based compression to accelerate LLM training across DP, TP and PP; training-time efficiency.
Activation rematerialization and hybrid parallelism for LLM training. No abstract, but the title names training-time activation memory directly.
3D stacked capacitorless DRAM accelerator for LLMs; hardware memory technology rather than a training method.
Accumulator-aware post-training quantization for LLMs; inference platforms by its own framing.
LLM accuracy on the registered dietitian exam; domain evaluation.
IR-QLoRA improves LoRA-finetuning quantization of LLMs through information retention; core B1/B2 intersection.
Fine-tuning of quantized LLMs balancing quantization against LoRA degradation; core B1/B2 intersection.
Dimension-free federated communication via zeroth-order optimization, framed for large-model scenarios. Memory-efficient optimization is in scope; the LLM tie is indirect.

'Achieving peak performance for large language models: A systematic review', 58 citations, no abstract available. A systematic review of LLM performance plausibly covers efficiency, but the title cannot confirm the subject.
Activation sparsity to compress LLMs for edge deployment; inference-side compression.
